members.name: fileList

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: The current file list, available through v-model:fileList. The component syncs external entries by id and preserves in-progress upload state.

members.name: limit
members.description: Maximum number of files. Once reached, additional files are skipped and the limit error is reported through onError.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Whether to allow selecting multiple files at once. When false, the picker keeps only the first file.

members.name: accept
members.description: The accepted file type hint passed to the native picker and used to validate selected files.

members.name: maxSize
members.description: Maximum size of one file in bytes. Oversized files are skipped and reported through onError.

members.name: maxRetries
members.description: Maximum retry attempts per file. Once reached, another retry reports an error and does not start an upload.

members.name: beforeUpload
members.description: A synchronous or asynchronous check run before a file is added to the list. Returning false skips that file.

members.name: beforeRemove

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: A synchronous or asynchronous confirmation run before removal. Returning false keeps the file in the list.

members.name: httpRequest

references.name: UploadRequestOptions

members.description: The asynchronous upload implementation. It receives the file, abort signal, progress callback, and success/error callbacks. Without it, files can still be added to the list but no upload starts.

members.name: listType
members.description: Selects the text, picture, or picture-card layout for file entries.

members.name: autoUpload
members.description: Whether to start uploading as soon as a validated file is added. When false, retryUpload can start the upload explicitly.

members.name: drag
members.description: Enables or disables file dropping on the trigger area.

members.name: onError

references.name: UploadError
UploadFile

members.description: Called for file type, size, or count validation failures, upload failures, and retry-limit errors.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the Upload root container.

members.name: update:fileList

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Emits a copy of the file list after a file is added or removed to update v-model:fileList.

members.name: file-change

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Emitted after a validated file is added to the internal list. Its status is ready, and this occurs before upload completion even when autoUpload is true.

members.name: file-remove

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Emitted after removal completes, provided beforeRemove did not reject it and the file was present in the list.

members.name: file-success

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Emitted when the custom upload implementation calls onSuccess. Canceled uploads do not emit this event.

members.name: file-error

references.name: UploadError
UploadFile

members.description: Emitted when the upload callback reports an error, the upload Promise rejects, or retries are exhausted. Validation failures call onError without emitting this event.

members.name: trigger

type.text: { selectFiles: (files: FileList | File[]) => Promise<void>; limit: number | undefined; multiple: boolean; accept: string | undefined; drag: boolean; }

members.description: Replaces the file-selection trigger area. Its scope provides selectFiles, limit, multiple, accept, and drag for custom controls.

members.name: file-list

type.text: { files: { id: string; name: string; size: number; type: string; status: "success" | "error" | "ready" | "uploading" | "canceled"; progress: number; url?: string | undefined; raw?: { readonly lastModified: number; readonly name: string; readonly webkitRelativePath: string; readonly size: number; readonly type: string; arrayBuffer: () => Promise<ArrayBuffer>; bytes: () => Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>>; slice: (start?: number | undefined, end?: number | undefined, contentType?: string | undefined) => Blob; stream: () => ReadableStream<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>>; text: () => Promise<string>; } | undefined; error?: { message: string; code?: string | undefined; status?: number | undefined; } | undefined; retryCount?: number | undefined; abortController?: { readonly signal: { readonly aborted: boolean; onabort: ((this: AbortSignal, ev: Event) => any) | null; readonly reason: any; throwIfAborted: () => void; addEventListener: { <K extends keyof AbortSignalEventMap>(type: K, listener: (this: AbortSignal, ev: AbortSignalEventMap[K]) => any, options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions | undefined): void; (type: string, listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject, options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions | undefined): void; }; removeEventListener: { <K extends keyof AbortSignalEventMap>(type: K, listener: (this: AbortSignal, ev: AbortSignalEventMap[K]) => any, options?: boolean | EventListenerOptions | undefined): void; (type: string, listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject, options?: boolean | EventListenerOptions | undefined): void; }; dispatchEvent: (event: Event) => boolean; }; abort: (reason?: any) => void; } | undefined; }[]; listType: "text" | "picture" | "picture-card"; remove: (file: UploadFile) => Promise<void>; retry: (file: UploadFile) => Promise<void>; }

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Replaces the file list. Its scope provides the current files, listType, and remove(file) and retry(file) actions.

members.name: default
members.description: Renders additional content after the trigger and file list; it has no scoped parameters.

members.name: handleFileSelect
members.description: Programmatically submits a FileList or File array through the same validation, beforeUpload, list update, and optional auto-upload flow.

members.name: handleFileRemove

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Programmatically removes a file. The operation still honors beforeRemove and aborts an in-progress upload.

members.name: retryUpload

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Programmatically retries a file. Successful files are not retried, and the attempt is limited by maxRetries.

members.name: file

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: The file to render, including its upload status, progress, and error details.

members.name: listType
members.description: Selects the text, picture, or picture-card layout for this file item.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the file item root element.

members.name: remove
members.description: Emitted without a payload when the user activates the remove button; the parent handles removal.

members.name: retry
members.description: Emitted without a payload only when the file is in error state and the user activates the retry button.

members.name: files

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: The file entries to render. The container is not rendered when the list is empty.

members.name: listType
members.description: The text, picture, or picture-card layout applied to each file item.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the file list container.

members.name: remove

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Forwards the corresponding UploadFile when a child item emits remove.

members.name: retry

references.name: UploadFile

members.description: Forwards the corresponding UploadFile when a child item emits retry.

members.name: drag
members.description: Whether to handle file-drop events. When disabled, drops are ignored and the dragging state is cleared.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables file selection and dropping, and removes the trigger area from the keyboard tab order.

members.name: accept
members.description: The accept type hint passed to the hidden native file input.

members.name: multiple
members.description: The multiple-selection setting passed to the native input. When false, both browsing and dropping keep only the first file.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the focusable trigger area.

members.name: select
members.description: Emitted with a non-empty file array after browsing or dropping, along with the browse or drop source. The array contains at most one file when multiple is false.

members.name: default
members.description: Replaces the entire trigger area. Its scope provides the live isDragging state and triggerFileInput() to open the file picker programmatically.

members.name: text
members.description: Replaces the main prompt inside the built-in trigger area and is used when the default slot is absent. Without this slot, the source currently renders a hardcoded Chinese prompt meaning “Click or drop files here to upload”; this text is not locale-aware.

members.name: hint
members.description: Replaces the helper text below the main prompt. The area is empty when this slot is not provided.
